IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight brown
hair and blunt bangs stands against a pale
backdrop. She wears a cream ribbed long-sleeve
henley with a scoop neckline, a small embroidered
monogram, and two black stripes across the chest.
A black drawstring mini skirt has contrast white
piping at the sides and a matching embroidered
monogram. Thumbhole cuffs and a thin black
choker complete the look. Her expression is calm
and direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of cream,
black, and white. Crisp and sporty, in the style of a
streetwear athleisure lookbook.
